retrievalProfile.description: Use this skill for 1980s-inspired layouts featuring bold, slanted display type, checkerboard circular frames, and a central product focus against a dark vignette.
excludeWhen: pastel or soft color palettes are required
flat vector illustrations without depth are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring a central photographic subject framed by a yellow and black checkerboard ring, set against a black background with a soft central spotlight. The top is dominated by a large, slanted, red sans-serif title block overlapping a yellow trapezoidal shape.
coreVisualRelationships: Title block anchored to the top third with aggressive forward slant
Central subject framed by a circular checkerboard graphic
Symmetrical columns of secondary text flanking the central image
High contrast between black background and bright primary color accents
coreInvariants: Yellow and black checkerboard circular border
Slanted red display typography with black outlines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central focal point, occupying the middle third of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red title block at the top serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top title, moves down to the central framed image, then scans the flanking text columns.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of solid black negative space to emphasize the central spotlight and top graphics.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation primaries (Red/Yellow) against a zero-value black background.

letterConstructionRules: Varying baseline heights for a 'staggered' look
Thick black outlines around red fills
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' characters are often elongated or compressed to fit the staggered baseline
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive custom display type paired with clean, functional bold sans-serif for secondary information.

avoid: Centering the title without the slant

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed structure for the display type.
Good for the secondary text columns to maintain the 80s feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid black background with a soft white radial spotlight in the center. Place a circular ring with a yellow and black checkerboard pattern inside the spotlight area. At the top, place a bright yellow trapezoid shape.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold, red slanted uppercase text with black outlines over the yellow trapezoid. Below that, add a blue horizontal bar with white bold sans-serif text. Flank the central circle with two symmetrical columns of white sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the title text slanted forward?
Is the checkerboard ring present and circular?
Is the background solid black with a central vignette?
Are the primary colors Red and Yellow dominant in the top graphic?

mustRedesign: Drop shadows on the main title
Lowercase letters in the display title
postGenerationChecks: Check that the red title has a thick black outline.
Ensure the checkerboard pattern is strictly yellow and black.
Verify the central image is contained within the ring.
Confirm the text columns are vertically aligned.
Check that the yellow trapezoid is behind the red text.
